_source: Doug, 2026-09-13, from a Copilot thread he directed. Organised and de-duplicated here, nothing discarded.
_intent: A FINDING aid, not an authority. Doug: 'The list I am going to give and the existing overlay are for finding, but not intended to override the principles. At the end of the day we stay true to the text and surface what is there.' A stamp is a claim that the text shows this, and must cite the verse that shows it. Where the taxonomy expects something the text does not say, the text wins and the stamp is absent.
_use: Stamp section-level nodes so patterns can be ranked by interest, related across the corpus, and navigated up and down the graph.

significant_events._note: 200 events in 20 domains of 10. Copilot was explicit that no scholarly list of this exact shape exists; it is a construction, useful for finding and not an authority. _levels.rule: A stamp may be descended only to its own level and no further. Ascent is by PROPORTION (what fraction of children carry it), never by union -- union is monotonic, so a book node would carry nearly the whole vocabulary and distinguish nothing.
_levels.basis: Measured 2026-09-12: 1 trait of 12 survived the informativeness filter at verse level, 12 at section level. A verse is too small to BE citation-heavy or an exodus pattern.
